description_en: Queries the pre-billing information for a specified batch of an enterprise. The result is returned as a download link
description_zh: 通过调用本接口可以查询指定批次预出账的账单信息，结果将以下载链接的形式返回
name: MonthPreBillGet

parameters.help_en: The billing month in yyyyMM format
parameters.name: bill_month

parameters.help_en: The header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise Access Token" operation (added in the header). In HTTP mode, you can use so_corp_token=value or dtb_corp_token=value in the URL as a substitute
parameters.help_zh: header参数 由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用so_corp_token=value或者dtb_corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token

parameters.help_en: The bill batch. In periodic billing, the format is yyyyMMdd
parameters.help_zh: 账单批次,周期出账时 格式为yyyyMMdd
parameters.name: bill_batch
